name: OcuClaw
description: OcuClaw for Even Realities G2 smart glasses.

relayToken.label: Relay token
relayToken.help: Shared secret. Must match the relay server token set in the OcuClaw app inside Even Hub. An owner host grant is authorized by possession of this token; shared or hosted installs should set glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy to operator-only.

glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy.label: LiveUI HTTP host policy
glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy.help: owner-grants lets the paired phone owner approve exact hosts. Use operator-only on shared or hosted installs.

sonioxApiKey.label: Soniox API key
sonioxApiKey.help: Optional. Enables Soniox speech-to-text for voice input.

typesafeApiKey.label: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.help: Optional. Saved from the phone's Silent input settings; arms smart word order (TypeSafe ranking) for the glasses keyboard.

cartesiaApiKey.label: Cartesia API key
cartesiaApiKey.help: Optional. Enables Cartesia Ink-2 speech-to-text for voice input.

evenAiEnabled.label: Enable Even AI
evenAiEnabled.help: Routes Even AI agent requests through OcuClaw. Requires evenAiToken when enabled.

evenAiToken.label: Even AI token
evenAiToken.help: Shared secret. Must match the password set in the Even AI Agent Configure section of the Even Realities app. Required when evenAiEnabled is true.

evenAiSystemPrompt.label: Even AI system prompt
evenAiSystemPrompt.help: Optional extra system prompt appended to Even AI runs only.

sessionTitleModel.label: Session-title model
sessionTitleModel.help: Optional model override ("provider/model") for the background session-title distiller. This is a lightweight background task, so a small, fast, inexpensive model is a good choice (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5). Leave blank to use your normal model.

evenAiRoutingMode.label: Even AI routing mode
evenAiRoutingMode.help: active = current session; background = dedicated background session; background_new = fresh background session per request.

wsBind.label: WebSocket bind address
wsBind.help: Local interface the OcuClaw relay listens on.

wsPort.label: WebSocket port
wsPort.help: Local port the OcuClaw relay listens on.

sessionLimit.label: WebUI session list size
sessionLimit.help: Recent sessions fetched for the WebUI switcher/search list. Glasses clamp to their own item-count cap.

debugNoisyPolicies.label: Debug noise policies
debugNoisyPolicies.help: Per-channel filters that suppress or sample noisy debug events.

externalDebugToolsEnabled.label: External debug tools
externalDebugToolsEnabled.help: Allow debugctl-style external tools to call debug-set, debug-dump, and remote-control.

debugAutoArm.label: Auto-arm app debug
debugAutoArm.help: Continuously lease app-side debug categories on developer hosts. Defaults to the External debug tools setting.

allowDebugUpload.label: Allow debug bundle upload
allowDebugUpload.help: Allow the relay to hand the full diagnostic bundle to the phone for user-initiated upload. Local assembly and save do not require this flag. Requires External debug tools. Off by default.

debugUploadMaxZipBytes.label: Debug upload max zip size (bytes)
debugUploadMaxZipBytes.help: Maximum compressed (uploaded) bundle size; the binding upload cap. Oldest events are trimmed until the zip fits.

debugUploadCapturePreset.label: Debug upload capture preset (override)
debugUploadCapturePreset.help: Optional override of the always-armed debug-upload capture category list.

debugBundleSaveDir.label: Debug bundle save directory
debugBundleSaveDir.help: Directory for locally-saved debug bundles. Empty = ~/.openclaw/ocuclaw-debug-bundles.

silentInputJev.enabled.label: Enable silent input Jev ranker
silentInputJev.enabled.help: Off by default: arming this sends the wearer's draft, and the message they are answering, to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai), which ranks words the host builds instead of a reasoning model writing them. Strictly opt-in per gateway. Only a literal true arms it. Changing this or the key takes a gateway restart.

silentInputJev.apiKey.label: TypeSafe API key (silent input)
silentInputJev.apiKey.help: API key for the silent input Jev ranker's TypeSafe calls. Falls back to TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the gateway's env block, then the process environment. Read once at start; rotating it takes a gateway restart.

silentInputJev.budgetMs.label: Silent input Jev budget (ms)
silentInputJev.budgetMs.help: Wall-clock budget for the ranking request. Past it the word keeps the keyboard's own local ranking, with no error shown. Default 2500, measured: a real 8-question request took 1.6 s cold and 1.35 s warm. Clamped 200-5000.

evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.label: Even AI dedicated session key (deprecated)
evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.help: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. Internal session key prefix for background routing. Must start with 'ocuclaw:'.

renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.label: render_glasses_ui timeout (ms)
renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.help: Terminal janitor for non-refresh render_glasses_ui surfaces: how long a surface may stay live before the handler force-resolves the call as { result: "timeout" }. NOT the interaction listen window — that is the tool-call timeoutMs input (default 90s), which expires nonterminally (window_expired) leaving the surface live. Bounds the orphan tool_use corruption window if the gateway dies mid-render. Default 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 disables (infinite wait — pre-2026-05-23 behaviour).

freshnessWindowMs.label: Activity summary freshness window
freshnessWindowMs.help: Milliseconds an agent summary outranks a tool label (3000-8000).

relayToken.description: Shared secret matching the OcuClaw relay token in the Even Hub app. Required before the relay can start. An owner host grant is authorized by relay-token possession, so a shared or hosted install should set glassesUiLive.httpHostPolicy to operator-only.

wsBind.description: Local interface the relay WebSocket listens on.

wsPort.description: Local port the relay WebSocket listens on. Left unset, a fresh install is assigned 47800 at first relay start (and the choice is written here); pre-existing installs keep 9000.

sessionLimit.description: Number of recent sessions fetched for the WebUI session switcher/search list (glasses clamp to their own item-count cap).

debugPayloadMaxBytes.description: Deprecated and ignored: debug payload truncation was removed (2026-05-13); this key has no effect. Retained in the schema only so existing configs that still set it continue to validate.

debugNoisyPolicies.description: Per-channel filters that suppress or sample noisy debug events.

externalDebugToolsEnabled.description: Allow debugctl-style external debug tools to use debug-set, debug-dump, and remote-control.

debugAutoArm.description: Continuously lease app-side debug categories on developer hosts. When omitted, follows externalDebugToolsEnabled.

allowDebugUpload.description: Allow the relay to hand the full diagnostic bundle to the phone for user-initiated upload. Local assembly and save do not require this flag. Requires externalDebugToolsEnabled. Off by default.

debugUploadMaxZipBytes.description: Maximum compressed (uploaded) bundle size (bytes); the binding upload cap, kept under the upload backend's limit. Oldest events are trimmed until the zip fits.

debugUploadCapturePreset.description: Optional override of the always-armed debug-upload capture preset (list of category names).

debugBundleSaveDir.description: Directory for locally-saved debug bundles; empty = ~/.openclaw/ocuclaw-debug-bundles.

sonioxApiKey.description: Optional Soniox API key. Enables Soniox speech-to-text for voice input.

typesafeApiKey.description: Optional TypeSafe API key saved from the phone (#3359). A present key arms silentInputJev unless silentInputJev.apiKey/enabled are set explicitly.

cartesiaApiKey.description: Optional Cartesia API key. Enables Cartesia Ink-2 speech-to-text for voice input.

evenAiEnabled.description: Route Even AI agent requests through OcuClaw. When true, evenAiToken is required.

evenAiToken.description: Shared secret matching the password set in the Even AI Agent Configure section of the Even Realities app. Required when evenAiEnabled is true.

evenAiSystemPrompt.description: Extra system prompt appended to Even AI runs only.

evenAiRequestTimeoutMs.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Timeout (ms) for Even AI upstream requests.

evenAiMaxBodyBytes.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Maximum response body size (bytes) accepted from the Even AI upstream.

evenAiDedupWindowMs.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Dedup window (ms) for collapsing repeated Even AI requests.

inputPredictionTimeoutMs.description: Silent input (#2829): host-side deadline (ms) for one direct next-word prediction call. Absent = the provisional 1500 ms. Operator/bench knob; phones cannot set it.

silentInputJev.description: Silent input Jev ranker (#3124): the host builds the candidate words from its own tables and asks TypeSafe (api.typesafe.ai) to rank them, instead of asking a reasoning model to write them. Off by default because arming it sends the wearer's draft and the message being answered to that third-party API; strictly opt-in per gateway.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off by default: this sends the wearer's draft, and the message they are answering, to a third-party API (api.typesafe.ai). An operator must opt in explicitly per gateway.

apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for the silent input Jev ranker. Falls back to the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable when unset, so a pet/dev box can supply the key without writing a secret into openclaw.json.

budgetMs.description: Wall-clock budget for one ranking request. Past it the word falls back to the keyboard's own local ranking with no error shown.

evenAiRoutingMode.description: Even AI session routing: active uses the current session, background reuses a dedicated session, background_new starts a fresh session per request.

evenAiDedicatedSessionKey.description: Deprecated — scheduled for removal in a future release. The built-in default is used when this key is absent. Internal session key prefix for background Even AI routing. Must start with 'ocuclaw:'.

renderGlassesUiTimeoutMs.description: Terminal janitor for non-refresh render_glasses_ui surfaces: how long a surface may stay live before the handler force-resolves the call as { result: "timeout" }. NOT the interaction listen window — that is the tool-call timeoutMs input (default 90s), which expires nonterminally (window_expired) leaving the surface live. Bounds the orphan tool_use corruption window if the gateway dies mid-render. Default 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 disables (infinite wait — pre-2026-05-23 behaviour).

glassesUiLive.description: Live-refresh glasses surfaces (render_glasses_ui refresh recipes): master switch plus per-tier operator controls for timer network requests and model calls.

enabled.description: Master switch for live-refresh surfaces. When false, every refresh block is rejected (refresh_disabled); static renders are unaffected.

httpEnabled.description: Allow http refresh recipes to make scheduled outbound requests from the gateway host. An explicit false blocks the tier. Every enabled request still needs an operator-listed host or, under owner-grants, an exact host approved on the paired phone, and the executor blocks loopback/private/link-local/metadata destinations.

httpHostPolicy.description: owner-grants delegates approval of exact HTTP hosts to the paired phone owner; operator-only accepts only httpAllowHosts. Shared or hosted installs should use operator-only.

httpAllowHosts.description: Operator host allowlist for http recipes. Entries are exact hostnames, or ".example.com" to allow a domain and its subdomains. Under owner-grants, exact phone-owner grants may authorize additional hosts; under operator-only an empty list rejects every http recipe.

llmEnabled.description: Allow llm refresh recipes to make bounded model calls on a schedule. An explicit false blocks the tier; when no tick model or backend is set, the runtime uses a small default for a supported host provider and disables the tier when no backend maps.

tickBackend.description: HTTP API backend for llm ticks. Only these two values validate; the removed CLI-spawn backends (claude-cli/codex-cli) are rejected here, and any unknown value that reaches the runtime coerces to anthropic-api.

tickModel.description: Model for llm ticks. Unset adopts the host provider and uses its small backend default: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for Anthropic or gpt-4o-mini for OpenAI.

tickApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the openai-compat backend. Unset defaults to https://api.openai.com.

allowAgentModelOverride.description: Allow an agent-authored recipe to override tickModel per tick. Off by default so the operator's model and spend choice holds; overrides are rejected (refresh_llm_model_override_denied).

tickMaxOutputTokens.description: Output-token cap per llm tick; bounds spend and display length.

maxConcurrentSurfacesPerHost.description: Variant-A stage lease cap. Counts sessions with non-empty LiveUI stacks and rejects a brand-new session at the limit; no existing surface is destroyed.

stageGraceMs.description: How long a listening/inflight stage holder may block another session before the exclusive lease can transfer as grace_expired.

freshnessWindowMs.description: How long (ms) a fresh agent summary stays preferred over a tool label in the glasses activity status. Clamped 3000-8000.

sessionTitleModel.description: Optional model override ("provider/model") for the background session-title distiller. This is a lightweight background task, so a small, fast, inexpensive model is a good choice (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5). When absent, the user's normal model is used.

evenTerminal.description: Deprecated compatibility input. Accepted so existing configuration still loads, but ignored and unable to enable any runtime behavior.
